note: Glaze 1.0.39: choosing a theme now puts its widget art in place straight away. Use this theme (or any theme choice) downloads the theme if needed and fills Artwork 1-5. The Widgets tab shows Preparing, then the five pieces, with no need for Use everything or a Home Screen widget first. The three original themes that had only one small artwork (Deep Sea, Starry Night, Sunset Dunes) leave the gallery; anyone using one keeps it. Every theme in the gallery now has five different artworks.
